description.description: One line on what it is.

can_store.description: Whether [`SecretProvider::put`] and [`SecretProvider::forget`] work: it keeps what it is given.

can_list.description: Whether [`SecretProvider::names`] answers: it can say what it holds.

needs_person.description: Whether answering needs a person at the screen (a form to fill, a vault to unlock): the host asks it of no session whose person is not there.

name.description: The name the secret is kept under; see [`name_problem`].
The name to keep it under; see [`name_problem`].

value.description: The value; absent when the provider holds nothing under that name.

expires_in.description: How many seconds from now the value stops being good (a token that expires, a credential with an end), or absent when it has no end of its own. A host keeps it no longer than this, whatever the person chose.

names.description: Every name the provider holds, each one [`name_problem`] accepts.
